# Moar v5.0.0 - Table of Contents

> A dependency-free utility library containing 100+ useful functions.

## Pages

- [Moar](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/license.md)
- [Changelog](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [Moar.Assertions](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/Moar.Assertions.md): ExUnit assertions.
- [Moar.Atom](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/Moar.Atom.md): Atom-related functions.
- [Moar.Code](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/Moar.Code.md): Code-related functions
- [Moar.DateTime](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/Moar.DateTime.md): DateTime-related functions. See also `Moar.NaiveDateTime`.

- [Moar.Difference](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/Moar.Difference.md): A protocol that defines `diff/2` for finding the difference between two terms.
- [Moar.Duration](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/Moar.Duration.md): A duration is a `{time, unit}` tuple.
- [Moar.Enum](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/Moar.Enum.md): Enum-related functions.
- [Moar.File](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/Moar.File.md): File-related functions.
- [Moar.IO](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/Moar.IO.md): IO-related functions
- [Moar.IO.ANSI](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/Moar.IO.ANSI.md)
- [Moar.Integer](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/Moar.Integer.md): Integer-related functions.
- [Moar.List](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/Moar.List.md)
- [Moar.Map](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/Moar.Map.md): Map-related functions.
- [Moar.NaiveDateTime](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/Moar.NaiveDateTime.md): NaiveDateTime-related functions. See also `Moar.DateTime`.

- [Moar.Opts](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/Moar.Opts.md): Extracts keys and values from enumerables, especially from function options.
- [Moar.Protocol](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/Moar.Protocol.md): Protocol-related functions.
- [Moar.Random](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/Moar.Random.md): Generates random data.
- [Moar.Regex](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/Moar.Regex.md): Regex-related functions.
- [Moar.Retry](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/Moar.Retry.md): Retryable functions.
- [Moar.String](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/Moar.String.md): String-related functions.
- [Moar.Sugar](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/Moar.Sugar.md): Syntactic sugar functions.
- [Moar.Term](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/Moar.Term.md): Blank/present functions for terms.
- [Moar.Tuple](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/Moar.Tuple.md): Tuple-related functions.
- [Moar.URI](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/Moar.URI.md): URI/URL-related functions.
- [Moar.UUID](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/Moar.UUID.md): UUID-related functions
- [Moar.Version](https://moar.hexdocs.pm/Moar.Version.md): Version-related functions.
